about: Curated fixes for gaps in the Spire Codex monster data, each with its sources (read: the page was read directly; otherwise only reported by a search summary). Applied as a catalog layer while the gap remains. See crates/spire-data/src/curated.rs.

sources.says: Attack Pattern: 1 Pheromone Spit, 2 Beeeees!, 3 Spear!, then back to the start.
Starts with Beeeees!; Pheromone Spit is followed by Beeeees! (Beeeees! and Spear! have no next move in the data).
Search summary of this page: a fixed cycle of Beeeees!, then Spear!, then Pheromone Spit, and back to the start.

entries.note: The cycle Codex lists, opened where Codex's data says the fight starts.

pattern.description: Sleep for 3 turns, then Slash → Disembowel → Slash2 → Soul Siphon → repeat (curated)

sources.says: Starts with Sleep. Opens the fight holding Plating 12 and Asleep 3.
Asleep: 'Awakens upon losing HP or after 2 turns.' (amount 3). Awake: Slash → Disembowel → Slash2 → Soul Siphon → Slash. The sleep state has no next move.
Search summary of guides including this one: sleeps for three turns (wakes early on losing HP); the awake cycle is Slash, Disembowel, Slash2, Soul Siphon.

entries.note: Asleep's text says 2 turns, its amount and the guides say 3: taken as 3. It wakes sooner if it loses HP, which is the player's choice, so the pattern shows the full sleep.

sources.says: Adaptable: 'When this creature would be defeated, it instead revives even stronger.' Respawn gains Painful Stabs and Nemesis; after reviving it uses Multi-Claw if respawns < 2, Lacerate (then Big Pounce, Burning Growl) if respawns >= 2. No HP given.
Search summary of guides including this one: Phase 1: 100/111 + Phase 2: 200/212 + Phase 3: 300/313 = ~600 total (base / Ascension 8+).
Search summary of this page: three phases; the boss was reworked in January 2026, so older guides may be out of date.

entries.note: HP per phase is from guides only (not read here). The turn spent reviving isn't counted.

pattern.description: Writhe, Bulk or Constrict, never the same twice in a row (curated)

sources.says: Attack Pattern: any of these, in no fixed order: Writhe, Bulk, Constrict (plus Reattach and Dead). Opens the fight holding Reattach 25.
Search summary of this page: Writhe never repeats, Bulk never repeats, Constrict never repeats; a dead segment revives in 2 turns with 25 HP while other segments live.

entries.note: Reattach (a dead segment reviving while others live) isn't modelled: the fight reads as three segments to kill once.
